exposure: perception of risk and severity of pregnancy complications
cohort: The study included 160 pregnant women who attended antenatal care and family planning departments in Amnat Charoen Hospital and Sub-district Health Promoting Hospitals in Thailand.
finding: Significant associations were found between self-care behaviors and several factors, with access to services, perceived risk and severity of pregnancy complications, and social support being predictors of self-care behaviors.
cross-section timing: Data was collected from pregnant women visiting antenatal care and family planning departments within a calendar year.
